replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I used AI tools last year for algebra practice. It helped me check my work quickly and explained steps clearly. I felt more confident solving equations without getting stuck, though I still prefer manual practice for deeper understanding.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write the equation in standard form ax² + bx + c = 0. Then, calculate the discriminant b² - 4ac. If positive, two real solutions; zero, one solution; negative, complex solutions. Use the quadratic formula x = [-b ± √(b²-4ac)] / (2a) to find them.

To find stationary points, take the first derivative f'(x), set it equal to zero, and solve for x. Plug those x-values back into f(x) to get the y-coordinates. Check if they're maxima or minima using the second derivative test.
